meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 它会接管 oh-my-opencode 的发版流程:按你给出的 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,轮询到运行结束,再核对 GitHub release、npm 包版本等发布产物并汇报链接。
howto.when: 当你要求发布 oh-my-opencode 时触发,例如说出「publish」、「release」、「deploy」等关键词并带上版本选择器;若没给选择器,它会先停下来问你。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 触发发布工作流并轮询到结束
按 minor 递增触发发布
以明确语义化版本号触发发布

howto.what_en: It takes over oh-my-opencode releases: given patch, minor, major or an explicit semver, it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls until the run ends, then verifies the GitHub release and npm package versions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to publish oh-my-opencode — say "publish", "release" or "deploy" plus a selector; without a selector it stops and asks for patch, minor, major or an explicit version.

say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and polls to the end
Triggers a publish with a minor bump
Triggers a publish with that explicit semver
